dihedral.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((yellows (find-color g 4))
                  (yr1 (min-of first yellows))
                  (yc1 (min-of second yellows))
                  (yr2 (max-of first yellows))
                  (yc2 (max-of second yellows))
                  (template (for/list ((r (range yr1 (+ yr2 1))))
                              (for/list ((c (range yc1 (+ yc2 1))))
                                (let ((v (at g r c))) (casev v (hash 4 4 6 6) -1)))))
                  (rot-cw (lambda (tmpl)
                            (let ((rows (length tmpl))
                                  (cols (length (first tmpl))))
                              (for/list ((r (range 0 cols)))
                                (for/list ((c (range 0 rows)))
                                  (list-ref (list-ref tmpl (- rows 1 c)) r))))))
                  (flip-lr (lambda (tmpl) (map reverse tmpl)))
                  (t0 template)
                  (t1 (rot-cw t0))
                  (t2 (rot-cw t1))
                  (t3 (rot-cw t2))
                  (t4 (flip-lr t0))
                  (t5 (rot-cw t4))
                  (t6 (rot-cw t5))
                  (t7 (rot-cw t6))
                  (orientations (list t0 t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((tmpl orientations))
               (let ((tmpl-h (length tmpl))
                     (tmpl-w (length (first tmpl))))
                 (for* ((r (range 0 (min h (- (+ h 2) tmpl-h)))) (c (range 0 (min w (- (+ w 2) tmpl-w)))))
                       (let* ((mag-match (for*/sum ((tr (range 0 tmpl-h)) (tc (range 0 tmpl-w)))
                                                   (let ((gr (+ r tr))
                                                         (gc (+ c tc)))
                                                     (if (and
                                                           (>= gr 0)
                                                           (< gr h)
                                                           (>= gc 0)
                                                           (< gc w)
                                                           (= (list-ref (list-ref tmpl
                                                                                  tr)
                                                                        tc)
                                                              6)
                                                           (= (at g gr gc) 6))
                                                         1
                                                         0))))
                              (has-mismatch (for/or ((tr (range 0 tmpl-h)))
                                                    (for/or ((tc (range 0 tmpl-w)))
                                                            (let ((gr (+ r tr))
                                                                  (gc (+ c tc)))
                                                              (and
                                                                (>= gr 0)
                                                                (< gr h)
                                                                (>= gc 0)
                                                                (< gc w)
                                                                (let ((tv (list-ref (list-ref tmpl
                                                                                              tr)
                                                                                    tc))
                                                                      (gv (at g gr gc)))
                                                                  (or
                                                                    (and
                                                                      (= tv 6)
                                                                      (!= gv 6))
                                                                    (and
                                                                      (= tv 4)
                                                                      (= gv 6))))))))))
                         (when
                           (and (not has-mismatch) (>= mag-match 2))
                           (for* ((tr (range 0 tmpl-h)) (tc (range 0 tmpl-w)))
                                 (let ((gr (+ r tr))
                                       (gc (+ c tc)))
                                   (when
                                     (and
                                       (>= gr 0)
                                       (< gr h)
                                       (>= gc 0)
                                       (< gc w)
                                       (= (list-ref (list-ref tmpl tr) tc) 4))
                                     (hash-set! result (list gr gc) 4)))))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
